_about: Synthetic CHIRPS fixture (FEED_SOURCE=fixtures, backend/src/feeds/fixtures.ts). An invented 8 x 6 grid of 0.05° cells; no real place, catchment or measurement. The files cover `cover` (21.0-25.4° E, 20.0-34.0° S, where the seeded examples' synthetic catchments sit): the grid's own cells keep their values and every other cell repeats them (row mod 6, column mod 8), with no sea, so a feed over a seeded boundary reads offline (issue #326). Each day's grid is pattern[day % pattern.length] mm, scaled per cell by (1 + colGradient * col + rowGradient * row). The cell at row 5, col 7 is 'sea' (-9999). The fixture server re-dates the pattern to any day and publishes final values up to finalLagDays before today and preliminary ones up to prelimLagDays before it, like the real product. The v3 `sat` product is served from 1998-01-01 only; the `rnl` product (final only, published with the sat finals, so rnlLagDays matches finalLagDays) from 1981-01-01 up to rnlLagDays before today, as the same pattern a day later (its daily timing differs from sat's, as the real products' do).
